item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description:
This policy explains what information is collected when you visit salocal.info (“SA Local Info”, “we”, “us”) and how it is used. We are based in Cape Town, South Africa, and follow the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA).

The short version

  • You do not need an account to use this site, and we never ask for your ID number, banking details or passwords.
  • We use Google Analytics to count visits and Google AdSense to show ads. Both use cookies.
  • We do not sell your personal information.
  • If you email us, we use your email only to reply to you.

Information we collect

When you browse the site. We do not ask you for any personal information. Like most websites, the services below automatically receive technical information such as your IP address, browser and device type, the pages you visit and how you arrived at the site.
